title: Basta Ba Zanjeer
body:
basta ba zanjeer basta ba zanjeer
jumla yateema haye
aah hussaina shaahe shaheedan
basta ba zanjeer jumla yateema
<<DIVIDER>>
jalte huwe ghar lut'ti ridayein
kisko sada de kisko bulayein
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek zanjeer e sitam baara aseero ke galay
uspe ye hukm ke har peer o jawan tez chale
ee sitam haye hussaina
pusht pe padte rahe saath durron ke nishan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek beemar aseeron ka jo salaar bana
thaame zanjeer e sitam jaanibe darbar chala
ee sitam haye hussaina
roya shabbir ka sar barsare noke sina
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
dhoop se pyar hai saaye se sarokaar nahi
koi bano ki tarha bekas o ghamkhwar nahi
ee sitam haye hussaina
kaise asghar ke bina saaye mein jayegi maa
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme laila ka jigar hogaya paara paara
us ne dekha hai jawan laal ke dil mein naiza
ee sitam haye hussaina
moo ko aata hai jigar sunti hai jab bhi azan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek naushaah ki mayyat ke bahattar tukde
maadare qasim e muztar ki nazar se guzre
ee sitam haye hussaina
sar kahan jism kahan dil kahan haath kahan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jo lashkar ka alamdar tha daste shabbir
bar labe nehr likhi jisne wafa ki tehreer
ee sitam haye hussaina
wo nahi hai to nahi ab mere jism mein jaan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaan zakhmi hai gala khushk jala hai daaman
saans lene nahi deti hai sakina ko rasan
ee sitam haye hussaina
neend aati hai usay wo magar soye kahan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
beridayi ki aziyyat ko uthaane waale
haye wo aale mohamed ke gharane waale
ee sitam haye hussaina
apne is haal pe bhi kar nahi paaye fughan
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha rehaan aseeron ki zuban mein likh kar
is qadar roya qalam ho gaya khirtaas bhi tar
ay meri jaan hussaina
farshe majlis pe huwe qalb o jaan nauha kuna
aah hussaina...
basta ba zanjeer...
author: Rehaan Azmi
